static_traits.name: Wang Min
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support, often feeling no one to turn to when encountering difficulties
static_traits.medical_history: No history of major physical illness; no previous similar psychological problems or treatment experience
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, able to self-reflect, emotionally stable, highly cooperative, neutral attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that because of my unusual interests as a funeral director and stamp collector, I cannot connect with others, and I feel isolated and judged.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of isolation are affecting my mental health and overall well-being, prompting me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After starting the funeral director profession, when people around learned of the client's occupation, they often showed discomfort or responded with jokes; these experiences gradually made the client feel 'I do not belong here / I am not normal', and triggered a persistent experience of social isolation.

After gradually going deeper into the niche hobby of stamp collecting, the client's experienced social stereotypes and experiences of 'being labeled' deepened, further reinforcing the belief that 'others will therefore judge and distance me'.

Long-term living alone, no siblings, and a weak social support system to rely on make it difficult for the client to obtain emotional support when facing experiences of being misunderstood and judged, and the loneliness and isolation keep accumulating.

core_beliefs: have not人会接纳真正的我.

special_situations.event: When mentioning their occupation (funeral director) in social settings, others show discomfort or respond with jokes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others show discomfort or make fun of me, it means I am strange and they will reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintaining a polite smile and quickly changing the topic, reducing self-exposure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am strange; I do not belong here

special_situations.event: Before trying to meet new friends or preparing to attend social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others know my occupation and hobbies, they will surely look down on me and be unwilling to get close to me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding going out or reducing socializing, postponing or giving up making new friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be judged again; no one will like me

special_situations.event: When others discuss hobbies or mainstream topics, thinks of own stamp-collecting hobby as relatively niche
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only people who conform to the mainstream and are extroverted and social will be accepted; someone like me will be seen as a 'nerd / weirdo'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to hide real interests, catering to others' topics in order to be accepted
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a weirdo/nerd; others will not understand me

special_situations.event: When others respond to their profession and hobbies in a joking way
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am made fun of, it means the problem is entirely with me and I am fundamentally unwelcome
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing an air of ease and quickly changing the topic to reduce further interaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not accepted; I can only pretend nothing is wrong

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted as the true self, building meaningful intimate connections
core_conflict.fear: Fears that after exposing the true self they will be judged, humiliated, and rejected, and further isolated
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of rejection and shame by keeping distance and reducing self-disclosure
In interactions, controls the situation through politeness and changing topics, avoiding emotional hurt

object_relations.self_representation: A marginalized person who is misunderstood, odd, and not accepted
object_relations.object_representation: A group that is prejudiced and prone to judging and mocking others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others show discomfort about one's profession/hobby or respond in a joking manner
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others, like the people in the past, will judge and distance themselves from me (transferentially experiencing others as rejecters)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains polite and brief responses, quickly changes the topic, with a downplaying tone, avoiding expressing feelings of hurt or discomfort.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Early in a new relationship, being asked about one's occupation and interests
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Once the true self is revealed, will be rejected (experiencing real relationships as potential negation and abandonment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Selectively discloses information, emphasizes neutral content, and reduces personal emotional expression and detail sharing.

manifestations: Long-term living alone, no siblings, weak social support
Worrying about being judged in social situations and reducing going out and making new friends
Feeling labeled and not understood when asked about profession/hobby
outcomes: Persistent isolation and feelings of exclusion
Difficulty forming meaningful interpersonal connections, daily interaction affected

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths
manifestations: Repeatedly uses 'I should be more outgoing / I should hide myself' to constrain the self
Evaluating whether oneself is 'normal/acceptable' oriented toward conforming to the mainstream

contact_model.definition: The individual deliberately avoids direct contact or avoids triggering stimuli
manifestations: When others joke about their occupation or appear uncomfortable, laughs and changes the topic, avoiding deeper conversation
Minimizing self-exposure about real interests and values in social situations

positive_force: Has a clear sense of value and meaning regarding work and interests (loves funeral work and the stamp-collecting hobby)
Occupational functioning is good, work performance unaffected, with a stable daily structure
Has the ability to self-reflect and empathize with others (can be aware of the 'inner critic' and can express accepting language toward others)
Proactively seeking help and willing to try new perspectives and methods (seeking counseling)
negative_force: Over-relying on external evaluation to judge self-worth (seeking external validation)
Negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophic prediction, mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization
Social avoidance and self-concealment (reducing going out, changing topics)
A weak social support system; lacks a stable support network

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and self-concealment (going out less in social life, changing topics, hiding occupation and interests)
antecedent: Being asked about occupation or interests in social settings
Before preparing to meet new friends or attend a gathering
Observing others showing discomfort or joking about one's profession/hobby
target_behavior.core_reason: Worry about being judged and rejected, accompanied by mind reading and catastrophic predictions, and internalizing social stereotypes as self-labels
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluation and shame, protecting self-esteem and emotional safety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Isolation and loneliness worsen, making it hard to establish and maintain meaningful interpersonal relationships, with daily interactions and activities affected
